title: New Business Models for Gaming, Collaboration, Creativity

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: The combination of cloud, social.
reader_summary.overview: The combination of cloud, social, and mobile took gaming beyond a small base of just console- and PC-gamers to a massive player base. But the underlying business model -- the concept of "free-to-play". This balance becomes incredibly challenging over time; it is, quite frankly, a lopsided economy.

key_points.text: But the underlying business model -- the concept of "free-to-play".
The players will leave: The incentives between game publishers and players are simply not aligned.
Yet what if we could re-align those incentives -- really, the economic relationships -- between game publishers/developers; players and guilds and clans.
